verdict.rationale: The evidence documents several REST APIs (Job Board API, Candidate Ingestion API, Assessment Partner API), webhooks, and a developer sandbox, but nothing shows Greenhouse ships official SDK client libraries. Raw HTTP APIs are adjacent building blocks, not official SDKs, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec from which SDKs could be generated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
